newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 sees no inflation concerns in Europe - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: G10 sees no inflation concerns in Europe - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said that central bank governors of the Group of 10 (G10) countries believed inflation was under control in Europe.
"Inflation seems to be still under control," Tietmeyer said.
Speaking after a meeting of G10 central bank govenors, Tietmeyer said that the recent strengthening of the dollar had raised some import prices, which could have an impact on inflation.
"But all in all, there is no inflationary environment" up to now, Tietmeyer said.
"We don't see a special inflationary situation in Europe, but of course the situation is different from country to country," he said.

"For example, the U.K. is different from the continent, and we have to wait to see what will be the outcome of the elections. We have to wait and see what will be the policy then," Tietmeyer said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
